questions.question: The ratio of areas of two regular polygons with same number of sides is 4:9. What is the ratio of their side lengths?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two regular polygons with the same number of sides, they are geometrically similar.

The ratio of their corresponding sides is exactly the square root of the ratio of their areas.

Side ratio = √(Area ratio)

⇒ Side ratio = √(4 / 9) = 2 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of areas of two regular polygons = 4 : 9

Both polygons have an equal number of sides, say 'n'.

**Formula Used:**

Area of a regular polygon with 'n' sides = (n × a²) ÷ [4 × tan(180°/n)], where 'a' is the side length.

 
 Area = 4 
• Side 1 
 Area = 9 
• Side 2 
• 
 Ratio 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the sides of the two polygons be a₁ and a₂.

⇒ Let their areas be A₁ and A₂ respectively.

⇒ Since the number of sides 'n' is equal, the constant terms n and [4 × tan(180°/n)] will cancel out when calculating the ratio.

⇒ A₁ / A₂ = a₁² / a₂²

⇒ 4 / 9 = (a₁ / a₂)²

⇒ a₁ / a₂ = √(4 / 9)

⇒ a₁ / a₂ = 2 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Similarity of Regular Polygons

All regular polygons with the same number of sides are geometrically similar. The ratio of their areas is strictly the square of the ratio of their corresponding side lengths.

Perimeter Ratio

For any two similar figures, the ratio of their perimeters is precisely equal to the linear scale factor, which is the direct ratio of their corresponding side lengths.

Volume of Similar 3D Solids

If two 3D solids are similar, the ratio of their volumes is identical to the cube of the ratio of their corresponding linear dimensions (V₁ / V₂ = (a₁ / a₂)³).

questions.question: Average age of group A of 20 students is 40 years. Average age of group B of 40 students is 'x' years. Combined average age of group A and group B is 50 years. What is the value of 'x'?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of students in **Group A** to **Group B** = 20 : 40 = 1 : 2 Deviation of **Group A** from **Combined Average** = 50 − 40 = 10 Since the student ratio is 1 : 2, the deviation ratio is inverse, i.e., 2 : 1. If 2 units = 10, then 1 unit = 5. Value of x = 50 + 5 = 55. **∴ The correct answer is 55.**

questions.question: If cot A = x + (1)/(x), find cosec²A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the identity: cosec²A = 1 + cot²A

Square the given value: cot²A = (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

Substitute to find cosec²A = 1 + x² + 1/x² + 2 = x² + 1/x² + 3

**∴ The correct answer is x² + 1/x² + 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cot A = x + 1/x

**Formula Used:**

cosec²A − cot²A = 1 ⇒ cosec²A = 1 + cot²A

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ cosec²A = 1 + (x + 1/x)²

⇒ cosec²A = 1 + x² + 1/x² + (2 × x × 1/x)

⇒ cosec²A = 1 + x² + 1/x² + 2

⇒ cosec²A = x² + 1/x² + 3

**∴ The correct answer is x² + 1/x² + 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Trigonometric Identities

sin²A + cos²A = 1, sec²A − tan²A = 1, and cosec²A − cot²A = 1.

Basic Algebraic Expansions

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios

sin A = 1 ÷ cosec A | cos A = 1 ÷ sec A | tan A = 1 ÷ cot A.

questions.question: Two distinct grades of rice, one priced at ₹80 per kilogram and the other at ₹120 per kilogram, are amalgamated in an undisclosed proportion. The resultant blend is retailied at ₹132 per kilogram, securing a profit margin of 20% on the overall cost price. Determine the precise ratio in which the two rice varieties were intermingled.

Mean Cost Price = Selling Price × [100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)]

Mean Cost Price = 132 × (100 ÷ 120) = ₹110/kg

Using Alligation Cross-Multiplication directly:

Quantity Ratio = (120 − 110) : (110 − 80)

Quantity Ratio = 10 : 30 = 1 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 3.**

Alligation Ratio = (CP₂ − Mean CP) : (Mean CP − CP₁)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean CP of mixture = (132 × 100) ÷ (100 + 20)

⇒ Mean CP = 13200 ÷ 120 = ₹110/kg

Rule of Alligation

It allows finding the specific ratio in which two or more ingredients at given prices must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired average price. Ratio = (Dearer Price − Mean Price) : (Mean Price − Cheaper Price).

Mean Price Concept

The cost price of a unit quantity of the mixture is called its mean price. When using the alligation method, always ensure that all values (CP₁, CP₂, and Mean Price) are purely Cost Prices. Never use Selling Price directly in the alligation cross.

Repeated Replacement

If a vessel contains 'x' units of a pure liquid and 'y' units are taken out and replaced by water 'n' times, the quantity of pure liquid remaining = x × (1 − y ÷ x)ⁿ.

questions.question:
Simplify:

(1)/(sqrt{7)-sqrt{3}} + (1)/(sqrt{7)+sqrt{3}}
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For any expression of the form 1/(√x − √y) + 1/(√x + √y), the direct shortcut formula is 2√x ÷ (x − y).

Here, x = 7 and y = 3.

⇒ Result = 2√7 ÷ (7 − 3)

⇒ Result = 2√7 ÷ 4 = √7 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is √7/2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 1/(√7 − √3) + 1/(√7 + √3)

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ To simplify, take the LCM of the denominators:

⇒ Expression = [(√7 + √3) + (√7 − √3)] ÷ [(√7 − √3) × (√7 + √3)]

⇒ Numerator = √7 + √3 + √7 − √3 = 2√7

⇒ Denominator = (√7)² − (√3)² = 7 − 3 = 4

⇒ Expression = 2√7 ÷ 4

⇒ Expression = √7 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is √7/2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Rationalization

It is the process of removing surds or square roots from the denominator by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the denominator.

Algebraic Identities

The identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² is a crucial rule for clearing out radical denominators.

Conjugate Pairs

The conjugate of the binomial surd √x + √y is √x − √y. Their product directly gives a rational number (x − y).
</p

questions.question: Marked price of an article is 150 percent of the value of discount. Marked price is what percent of the selling price?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Marked Price** to **Discount** = 150 : 100 ⇒ 3 : 2.

**Selling Price** = **Marked Price** − **Discount** = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Required Percentage = (**Marked Price** / **Selling Price**) × 100 = (3 / 1) × 100 = 300%.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 percent.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price** = 150% of **Discount**

**Formula Used:**

**Selling Price** = **Marked Price** − **Discount**

Required % = (**Marked Price** / **Selling Price**) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46d288156aa50547dfb25835f32e14f6b357c0fcf5f7af0c6dbf94f32692e33c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Discount** = 100 units.

⇒ **Marked Price** = 150% of 100 = 150 units.

⇒ **Selling Price** = **Marked Price** − **Discount**

⇒ **Selling Price** = 150 − 100 = 50 units.

⇒ Required Percentage = (150 / 50) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 3 × 100 = 300%

**∴ The correct answer is 300 percent.**

**__Additional Information__**

Discount and Selling Price

The **Selling Price** is always calculated as **Marked Price** − **Discount**. If **Discount** is 0, then **Selling Price** equals **Marked Price**.

Mark-up Percentage

Mark-up % = [(**Marked Price** − **Cost Price**) / **Cost Price**] × 100. It shows how much the price is increased over the cost.

Percentage of Base Change

To find what percent A is of B, the formula is (A/B) × 100. In this question, the base is the **Selling Price**.</p

questions.question: If B is 25% more than A, and C is 20% more than B, then what is A : C?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the value of A be 100.

Since B is 25% more than A, B = 100 + 25 = 125.

Since C is 20% more than B, C = 125 + (20 / 100) × 125 = 125 + 25 = 150.

The ratio of A : C = 100 : 150 = 2 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

B is 25% more than A.

C is 20% more than B.

**Method Used:**

Fractional representation of percentage increase.

• 
 +25%
 
 
 B
 125
 
 
• 
 +20%

 150
 
 A : C = 100 : 150 = 2 : 3

**Calculations:**

⇒ 25% expressed as a fraction = 1 / 4

⇒ B = A + (1 / 4) × A = 5 / 4 × A

⇒ Ratio of A / B = 4 / 5

⇒ 20% expressed as a fraction = 1 / 5

⇒ C = B + (1 / 5) × B = 6 / 5 × B

⇒ Ratio of B / C = 5 / 6

⇒ To find the overall ratio A : C, multiply the individual ratios:

⇒ A / C = (A / B) × (B / C)

⇒ A / C = (4 / 5) × (5 / 6) = 20 / 30 = 2 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Converting percentages directly to simplified fractions helps in speeding up ratio calculations. Always memorize common fractions like 25% = 1/4 and 20% = 1/5.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two sequential ratios a:b and b:c is calculated by multiplying them: (a/b) × (b/c) = a/c. This provides the direct relationship between the first and last terms.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value undergoes multiple changes sequentially, you can multiply the base with successive scaling factors. For example: Final = Base × (1 + %1) × (1 + %2).
</p

questions.question: A hot-air balloon directly above point A is rising vertically at 2 m/s. An observer at point B, 500 m due east of A, watches the balloon. At the moment when the angle of elevation is 30°, how long until it reaches an angle of elevation of 60°? (Assume no horizontal drift.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered = Base × (tan θ₂ − tan θ₁)

Vertical Distance = 500 × (tan 60° − tan 30°) = 500 × (√3 − 1/√3)

Vertical Distance = 500 × (2/√3) = 1000/√3 m

Time = Distance / Speed = (1000/√3) / 2 = 500/√3 s

Time ≈ 500 / 1.73205 = 288.675 s

**∴ The correct option is (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance AB = 500 m

Rising speed (v) = 2 m/s

Initial angle (θ₁) = 30°

Final angle (θ₂) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Height / Base

Time = Distance / Speed

 
• 
• B (Observer) A C (30°) D (60°) 
• 
• 30° 
 60° 500 m Distance covered 

⇒ In ΔABC, tan 30° = AC / AB

⇒ 1 / √3 = AC / 500

⇒ AC = 500 / √3 m

⇒ In ΔABD, tan 60° = AD / AB

⇒ √3 = AD / 500

⇒ AD = 500√3 m

⇒ Vertical distance moved (CD) = AD − AC

⇒ CD = 500√3 − 500/√3 = 500(3 − 1) / √3 = 1000/√3 m

⇒ Time taken = Vertical distance / Speed

⇒ Time = (1000/√3) / 2 = 500/√3 s

⇒ Time = 500 / 1.73205 ≈ 288.675 s

**∴ The correct option is (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Trigonometric Ratios

For angles 30°, 45°, and 60°, tan values are 1/√3, 1, and √3 respectively. In height and distance problems, √3 is approximately 1.732.

Relation between Height and Distance

If the base distance remains constant, the change in height h₂ − h₁ = Base × (tan θ₂ − tan θ₁).

Vertical Motion

When an object moves vertically, the horizontal distance between the observer and the path of the object remains constant (Base = constant).

questions.question: A spherical balloon is inflated so that its radius increases from 5 cm to 10 cm. By what factor does its surface area increase?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere is directly proportional to the square of its radius: **A ∝ r²**.

Ratio of radii (r₂ ÷ r₁) = 10 ÷ 5 = 2

Ratio of surface areas = (2)² = 4

Thus, the surface area increases by a factor of **4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc867ea0ff6216c83836108413a132cbc45cbfcb4e6fdb6ca7f79490c1b3de48.png] 
**Given:**

Initial radius (r₁) = 5 cm

Final radius (r₂) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere (A) = 4 × π × r²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial surface area (A₁) = 4 × π × (5)² = 100π cm²

⇒ Final surface area (A₂) = 4 × π × (10)² = 400π cm²

⇒ Factor of increase = A₂ ÷ A₁

⇒ Factor of increase = 400π ÷ 100π = 4

Therefore, the surface area increases by a factor of **4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere of radius r is given by the formula **A = 4 × π × r²**.

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere of radius r is given by **V = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³**.

Scaling Factor for 3D Shapes

If all linear dimensions of a similar 3D object are scaled by a factor of k, then its surface area scales by **k²** and its volume scales by **k³**.</p

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, the centroid is at G(1, 2). If the vertices P and Q are at (3, -1) and (-2, 4) respectively, what are the coordinates of vertex R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If G is the centroid of a triangle PQR, the coordinates of the third vertex R can be calculated directly using the relation: R = 3 × G − (P + Q)

x-coordinate = 3 × 1 − (3 − 2) = 3 − 1 = 2

y-coordinate = 3 × 2 − (−1 + 4) = 6 − 3 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is (2, 3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Centroid of the triangle, G(x, y) = (1, 2)

Vertices, P(x₁, y₁) = (3, −1) and Q(x₂, y₂) = (−2, 4)

Let the third vertex be R(x₃, y₃).

**Formula Used:**

Centroid G(x, y) = [(x₁ + x₂ + x₃) ÷ 3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃) ÷ 3]

 

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 G(1, 2)
 
 
 Q(−2, 4)
 
 
 P(3, −1)
 
 
 R(x, y)

**Calculation:**

For the x-coordinate:

⇒ 1 = (3 − 2 + x₃) ÷ 3

⇒ 3 = 1 + x₃

⇒ x₃ = 2

For the y-coordinate:

⇒ 2 = (−1 + 4 + y₃) ÷ 3

⇒ 6 = 3 + y₃

⇒ y₃ = 3

**∴ The correct answer is (2, 3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

1. Centroid of a Triangle

It is the intersection point of all three medians of the triangle. The centroid divides each median in the ratio 2:1. The formula is [(x₁+x₂+x₃)/3, (y₁+y₂+y₃)/3].

2. Incenter of a Triangle

It is the point of intersection of internal angle bisectors. The coordinates are [(ax₁+bx₂+cx₃)/(a+b+c), (ay₁+by₂+cy₃)/(a+b+c)] where a, b, and c are side lengths.

3. Area of a Triangle

The area of a triangle given its three vertices is (1/2) × |x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)|.
</p

questions.question: Lalit can finish a work in 15 days. Laxman can finish the same work in 25 days. They work together for 5 days. If the rest of the work is finished by Lalit and Deven in 4 days, then in how many days can Deven alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(15, 25) = 75 units.

Lalit's efficiency = 75 ÷ 15 = 5 units/day | Laxman's efficiency = 75 ÷ 25 = 3 units/day.

Work completed by both in 5 days = 5 × (5 + 3) = 40 units.

Remaining work = 75 − 40 = 35 units, which Lalit and Deven do in 4 days.

Deven's efficiency = (35 ÷ 4) − 5 = 8.75 − 5 = 3.75 units/day.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Lalit to finish the work = 15 days

Time taken by Laxman to finish the work = 25 days

They work together for 5 days, and then Lalit and Deven finish the rest in 4 days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Lalit
 15
 75
 5
 
 

 Laxman
 25
 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Lalit + Laxman = 5 + 3 = 8 units/day

⇒ Work done by Lalit and Laxman in 5 days = 8 × 5 = 40 units

⇒ Remaining work to be done = 75 − 40 = 35 units

⇒ Lalit and Deven complete these 35 units in 4 days.

⇒ Combined efficiency of Lalit and Deven = 35 ÷ 4 = 8.75 units/day

⇒ Let Deven's efficiency be D.

⇒ 5 + D = 8.75

⇒ D = 8.75 − 5 = 3.75 units/day

⇒ Time taken by Deven alone to finish the whole work = Total Work ÷ D

⇒ Time taken = 75 ÷ 3.75 = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Works on the same mathematical principle as time and work, where inlet pipes have a positive efficiency and outlet (leak) pipes possess a negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Total wages are distributed among workers in the direct ratio of the total amount of work physically done by each individual, not simply by their daily efficiency unless they work for the same number of days.

Alternate Day Work

Calculate the total work done in one complete cycle of days, divide the total work by this cycle work to find the number of full cycles, and assign the remaining work to the correct person based on their starting turn.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the area of a regular hexagon to that of an equilateral triangle of the same side length?

A regular hexagon is constructed by joining 6 identical equilateral triangles at its center point.

If the side length of the regular hexagon is 'a', then each of these 6 interior triangles will also have a side length of 'a'.

Therefore, the area of the regular hexagon is exactly 6 times the area of an equilateral triangle having the same side length.

**∴ The correct answer is 6:1.**

Properties of a Regular Hexagon

A regular hexagon has 6 equal sides and 6 equal interior angles (each measuring 120°). The sum of all its interior angles is exactly 720°.

Circumradius

The distance from the center of a regular hexagon to any of its outward vertices is exactly equal to its side length. Thus, its circumradius (R) = a.

Inradius

The perpendicular distance from the center to the midpoint of any side acts as the height of the internal equilateral triangles. The inradius (r) = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Perimeter to Area Efficiency

For a specifically given perimeter, a regular hexagon encloses a significantly larger internal area compared to a square or an equilateral triangle.

questions.question: 92 - 31 + 22 { of } 2 + 38 div 2 - (29) + 13 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve using BODMAS priority: Of → Division → Addition/Subtraction.

Calculate "Of" and "Division" terms: 22 of 2 = 44 and 38 ÷ 2 = 19.

Expression becomes: 92 − 31 + 44 + 19 − 29 + 13.

Group positive and negative terms: (92 + 44 + 19 + 13) − (31 + 29) = 168 − 60.

Final result: 168 − 60 = 108.

**∴ The correct answer is 108.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

92 − 31 + 22 of 2 + 38 ÷ 2 − 29 + 13

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: B (Brackets), O (Of), D (Division), M (Multiplication), A (Addition), S (Subtraction).

**Calculations:**

⇒ 92 − 31 + (22 × 2) + 38 ÷ 2 − 29 + 13

⇒ 92 − 31 + 44 + 19 − 29 + 13

⇒ 61 + 44 + 19 − 29 + 13

⇒ 105 + 19 − 29 + 13

⇒ 124 − 29 + 13

⇒ 95 + 13

⇒ 108

**∴ The correct answer is 108.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS/VBODMAS Rule

This rule dictates the order of operations: Vinculum, Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Of Operator Significance

The "of" operator represents multiplication but must be solved before any division or standard multiplication in the expression.

Addition and Subtraction Priority

Addition and Subtraction have the same level of priority and should be solved from left to right or by grouping signs to avoid errors.

questions.question: A lent Rs. 5000 to B for a duration of 2 years and Rs. 3000 to C for a period of 4 years both at the same simple interest rate. In total, he received Rs. 2200 as interest from both borrowers. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent principal for 1 year = (5000 × 2) + (3000 × 4) = 10000 + 12000 = 22000

Total Simple Interest received = 2200

Rate = (Total Interest ÷ Equivalent Principal) × 100

Rate = (2200 ÷ 22000) × 100

Rate = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal lent to B = ₹5000, Time = 2 years

Principal lent to C = ₹3000, Time = 4 years

Total simple interest = ₹2200

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal × Rate × Time

(where Rate is taken as a decimal fraction r)

Lent to B₹5000 × 2 yrsLent to C₹3000 × 4 yrs

Total SI = ₹2200

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interest from B = 5000 × r × 2 = 10000r

⇒ Interest from C = 3000 × r × 4 = 12000r

⇒ Total Interest = 10000r + 12000r

⇒ 22000r = 2200

⇒ r = (2200 ÷ 22000) × 100

⇒ r = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 0.1 per annum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate in %, and T is Time in years.

Decimal vs Percentage Rate

When solving equations, the percentage rate R can be expressed directly as a decimal r (where r = R ÷ 100) making the SI calculation simply P × r × T.

Equivalent Principal

When multiple investments are made at the same simple interest rate, the overall principal equivalent to a 1-year term is the sum of the products of each Principal and its respective Time period.

Decrease in average = 78 ÷ 19 ≈ 4.11 runs.

Total innings = 20

Average score = 42

Exclusion in Averages

When a value greater than the average is removed, the new average of the remaining group decreases.

Inclusion in Averages

Combined Average

The combined average of two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and averages A₁ and A₂ is (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: Find the least number that must be added to 5600 to make it a perfect square.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Estimate square root: 70² = 4900 and 80² = 6400.

Check 75² using (n5)² trick: 7 × 8 = 56 → 5625.

Next perfect square after 5600 is 5625.

Least number to be added = 5625 − 5600 = 25.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 5600

**Method:**

Long division estimation to find the nearest higher perfect square.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37e14364d9e9c5db1abea3b8e048b3d7a169c2205b1eb0c49af4fdef71d94216.png] 

⇒ Finding the square root of 5600 using long division:

⇒ 7 × 7 = 49 (Remainder 7), bring down 00 → 700.

⇒ New divisor 14x: 144 × 4 = 576, 145 × 5 = 725.

⇒ Since we need to add a number, we take the higher square: 75².

⇒ 75² = 5625.

⇒ Required addition = 5625 − 5600 = 25.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Squaring numbers ending in 5

For a number (A5), the square is calculated as [A × (A + 1)] followed by 25. Example: 75² = (7 × 8)25 = 5625.

Perfect Square Properties

The last digit of a perfect square can only be 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9. It can never be 2, 3, 7, or 8.

Digit Sum of Perfect Squares

The digital root (sum of digits reduced to a single digit) of a perfect square is always 1, 4, 7, or 9.

questions.question: The ratio of the number of boys to the number of girls in a class is 9:7. If there are 96 students in the class, how many girls are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 9 (Boys) + 7 (Girls) = **16 units**.

Given, 16 units = **96 students**.

1 unit = 96 ÷ 16 = **6**.

Number of girls = 7 units = 7 × 6 = **42**.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Boys : Girls** = 9 : 7

**Total students** in the class = 96

**Formula Used:**

Value of a part = (Ratio of that part ÷ Sum of ratios) × Total value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83238b01712f8175272b9fd6dd78405988ab09db042f5efeec14e960de5ce751.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number of boys be 9x and girls be 7x.

⇒ Total students = 9x + 7x = 16x

⇒ 16x = 96

⇒ x = 96 ÷ 16

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Number of girls = 7x = 7 × 6

⇒ Number of girls = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A **ratio** compares two quantities by division. If a : b is the ratio, then the quantities can be taken as ax and bx.

Duplicate Ratio

The **duplicate ratio** of a : b is a² : b². For example, the duplicate ratio of 9 : 7 is 81 : 49.

Compounded Ratio

The **compounded ratio** of (a : b) and (c : d) is (a × c) : (b × d).

questions.question: Given: (p)/(a) + (q)/(b) + (r)/(c) = 1 and (a)/(p) + (b)/(q) + (c)/(r) = 0, where p, q, r and a, b, c are non-zero, then the value of (p²)/(a²) + (q²)/(b²) + (r²)/(c²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let x = p/a, y = q/b, and z = r/c. Given x + y + z = 1.

Given a/p + b/q + c/r = 0 ⇒ 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0 ⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0.

Using the **Algebraic Identity**: (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx).

1² = x² + y² + z² + 2(0) ⇒ x² + y² + z² = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** p/a + q/b + r/c = 1 and a/p + b/q + c/r = 0

**Formula Used:** (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ Let x = p/a, y = q/b, and z = r/c.

⇒ The second equation is a/p + b/q + c/r = 0, which is 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0.

⇒ Taking the LCM: (yz + xz + xy) / xyz = 0.

⇒ Since p, q, r, a, b, c are **non-zero**, xyz ≠ 0, thus xy + yz + zx = 0.

⇒ Now, square the first equation: (x + y + z)² = 1².

⇒ x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 1.

⇒ x² + y² + z² + 2(0) = 1.

⇒ (p/a)² + (q/b)² + (r/c)² = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Square Identity

The square of a trinomial is given by (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.

Reciprocal Sum Property

If the sum of the reciprocals of three **non-zero** numbers is zero (1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0), then the sum of their pairwise products is zero (xy + yz + zx = 0).

Sum of Cubes Identity

If a + b + c = 0, then the sum of their cubes satisfies the condition a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.</p

questions.question: A', 'B', and 'C' formed a consulting firm. Their capital investments were Rs. 6,00,000, Rs. 4,00,000, and Rs. 5,00,000, respectively. After 3 months, 'A' withdrew Rs. 1,00,000, and 'B' added Rs. 1,00,000. The partnership lasted for 9 months. What was the ratio of their effective capital contributions?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Capital = Capital × Time

A's effective capital = (6 × 3) + (5 × 6) = 18 + 30 = 48

B's effective capital = (4 × 3) + (5 × 6) = 12 + 30 = 42

C's effective capital = 5 × 9 = 45

Ratio = 48 : 42 : 45 = 16 : 14 : 15

**∴ The correct answer is 16:14:15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial investments: A = Rs. 6,00,000, B = Rs. 4,00,000, C = Rs. 5,00,000

After 3 months: A withdrew Rs. 1,00,000; B added Rs. 1,00,000

Total time of partnership = 9 months

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of Profit = Ratio of Effective Capital = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂) : (C₃ × T₃)

 A 6L × 3m 5L × 6m B 4L × 3m 5L × 6m C 5L × 9m 
• 0 3 Months 9 Months 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A's investment for first 3 months = Rs. 6,00,000

⇒ A's investment for remaining 6 months = 6,00,000 − 1,00,000 = Rs. 5,00,000

⇒ A's effective capital = (6,00,000 × 3) + (5,00,000 × 6) = 18,00,000 + 30,00,000 = Rs. 48,00,000

 

⇒ B's investment for first 3 months = Rs. 4,00,000

⇒ B's investment for remaining 6 months = 4,00,000 + 1,00,000 = Rs. 5,00,000

⇒ B's effective capital = (4,00,000 × 3) + (5,00,000 × 6) = 12,00,000 + 30,00,000 = Rs. 42,00,000

 

⇒ C's investment for entire 9 months = Rs. 5,00,000

⇒ C's effective capital = 5,00,000 × 9 = Rs. 45,00,000

 

⇒ Ratio of their effective capitals = 48,00,000 : 42,00,000 : 45,00,000

⇒ Canceling 1,00,000 from all terms, Ratio = 48 : 42 : 45

⇒ Dividing by 3, Ratio = 16 : 14 : 15

**∴ The correct answer is 16:14:15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Partnership

When all partners invest their capital for the exact same period, profits are distributed strictly in the ratio of their original investments.

Compound Partnership

When partners invest different amounts for different time periods, profits are distributed in the ratio of their effective capitals (calculated as Capital × Time).

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner receives a fixed salary or a certain percentage of total profit for managing the business operations, while the remaining profit is shared among all partners according to their effective capital ratios.

questions.question: A display stand is shaped like a right triangular prism. The triangular base is a right-angled triangle with perpendicular sides measuring 3 cm and 4 cm. The height of the prism is 10 cm. What is the ratio of the area of the largest rectangular face to the area of the smallest rectangular face of the prism?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The rectangular faces of a right triangular prism all share the exact same height.

Thus, their areas are strictly proportional to the side lengths of the triangular base.

The base sides are 3 cm, 4 cm, and the hypotenuse = √(3² + 4²) = 5 cm.

Area of largest face → corresponds to the largest side (5 cm).

Area of smallest face → corresponds to the smallest side (3 cm).

**∴ The correct answer is 5:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base of the prism = Right-angled triangle with perpendicular sides 3 cm and 4 cm.

Height of the prism = 10 cm.

 
 
 4 cm 3 cm 5 cm Base 30 cm² Small 40 cm² Medium 50 cm² Large 3 cm 4 cm 5 cm 
• 
• 
• 10 cm 

**Formula Used:**

Hypotenuse = √(Base² + Perpendicular²)

Area of rectangular face = Side of base × Height of prism

**Calculations:**

⇒ Hypotenuse of the base triangle = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 cm

⇒ The lengths of the 3 sides of the base are 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm.

⇒ Area of the smallest rectangular face = Smallest side × Height = 3 × 10 = 30 cm²

⇒ Area of the largest rectangular face = Largest side × Height = 5 × 10 = 50 cm²

⇒ Required Ratio = Area of largest face : Area of smallest face

⇒ Required Ratio = 50 : 30 = 5 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 5:3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Right Prism vs Oblique Prism

In a right prism, the lateral faces are always perpendicular to the bases, resulting in entirely rectangular lateral faces. In an oblique prism, the lateral edges are slanted and the lateral faces are parallelograms.

Total Surface Area of Prism

The total surface area (TSA) of any prism is given by: TSA = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × (Base Area). For a right prism, the Lateral Surface Area equals Perimeter of Base × Height.

Volume of a Prism

The volume of any given prism (both right and oblique) is calculated using the product of its base area and perpendicular height: Volume = Area of Base × Height.
